rule: Label positions are in original-image pixels, read from gridded copies of the stored originals. Each label records how sure the placement is. An 'uncertain' label must be checked by a Biology teacher before release. Originals are never edited; variants are separate files. Covering burnt-in text is an edit and is recorded in 'cover' with its reason.

labels.review: confident: ground tissue between epidermis and vascular ring
uncertain: phloem lies outside the xylem in each bundle; a sclerenchyma cap may sit outside it. Botanist to confirm the cells at this point
confident: large thick-walled vessels on the inner side of the bundle
uncertain: the dot marks one bundle between its xylem and phloem; a bracket or outline round the bundle would be clearer
